title: Law to create an online portal connecting mural artists with wall space
summary: This bill would require the Department of Cultural Affairs to build an online portal within six months of enactment linking artists with city mural programs and private property owners offering walls for murals. It would also create a program providing in-kind materials and services to property owners who host murals, and require an interactive map promoting the portal. A report on the program's progress would be due to the mayor and Council 24 months after the portal launches.
